about: Implemented provider x endpoint cells with no contract case, each with why (TestCoverageGrid in this package). kind: not_served (the upstream has no such endpoint, or the gateway never routes there), not_parsed (relayed, nothing parsed), no_upstream (answered without an upstream call), uncovered (served and parsed, no fixture yet: an accepted coverage gap). An entry whose cells gain a case, or that names a cell the adapter does not implement, fails as stale. CONTRACT_COVERAGE.md lists them.

cells.reason: OpenAI has no OCR endpoint: /v1/ocr is Mistral's API, which the openai adapter serves for the mistral preset (pinned by mistral@mistral-ocr-latest).

ProxyAssistantsRequest and StreamAssistantsRequest relay a 2xx body or stream unparsed, so there is no shape to drift; an error body goes through parseProviderError, which the openai suite's error cases pin. No fixture: Assistants calls create objects in the account, so the drift job could not record one either.

The Gemini API no longer serves Imagen: the official SDKs refuse image generation in Gemini Developer API mode (googleapis/python-genai@34b58fd1b2aa387dff5976bbefa1c1268958369f:google/genai/models.py Models._generate_images, "only supported in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform mode, not in Gemini Developer API mode", which tests/models/test_generate_images.py expects of every case; googleapis/go-genai@5407437c41c1854cb6235395b8e4abfa46be1626:models.go Models.generateImages) and google-gemini/cookbook@b06b824cf2ea29f9543ffa14adcee68b5f934a9b:quickstarts/Get_started_imagen.ipynb says Imagen models have been deprecated in the Gemini API. The v1beta discovery document still lists the generic models.predict, which names no model. CreateImage's :predict is pinned on Vertex AI by vertex@imagen-4.0-generate-001's images_basic.
The gemini adapter's ListModels returns nil without calling upstream (known gap G26); the Gemini API's list_models case pins that.
ListModels returns nil without calling Bedrock's ListFoundationModels or ListInferenceProfiles, so there is no upstream shape to pin; model-watch lists Bedrock itself (contractwatch BedrockLister).

The speech relay serves only its vendor's WebSocket API: ChatCompletion and StreamChatCompletion answer 501 not_supported, and ListModels lists the configured models, all without an upstream call. The relay itself is pinned by the speech sessions.
